{{Quote|For you, an enchanted blade, blessed with our most ''potent'' magicks.|Mother Talzin, to Savage Opress|<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>}}
A '''pike''' was a type of [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]] weapon employed in the culture of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was given a [[Savage's spear/Legends|pike]] by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], drawn forth from [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]], that was said to be enchanted with their most potent [[Dathomir Magic|magic]]. Pikes were also used by [[Dolandu]] who lived in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of [[Skalokor]]. One was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Niquon]] to protect himself from a [[Drethi/Legends|drethi]] attack.
